items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Because I played in Jimmy Coe's [band], on some situations with Coe and his band.

ctx.x: I was about to ask about LaVon.

. . . LaVon Kemp, yeah, playing for social situations around Indianapolis – dances, mostly, and social functions. LaVon Kemp and Jimmy Coe. Did Jimmy Coe have his band at that time, or that was later?
I think it came a little later.
